:::{#rem-data-splits}
#### What each set is for

Each set of a [training/validation/test split](#def-data-splits) has one job:

- the training set is used to fit each candidate model,
  which estimates its parameters;
- the validation set is used to compare the candidates,
  choose transformations,
  or choose values of a [tuning parameter](#def-tuning-parameter);
- the test set is used once, after the validation choice is made,
  to estimate the [generalization error](#def-generalization-error) of the chosen fitted model.

The chosen fitted model won on the validation set
partly because of that particular validation sample,
so its validation error is optimistic.
Keeping the test set out of every choice
is what makes its score free of that optimism.

For further reading, the machine learning notes define the same three sets in their own notation:
the [training set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-training-set),
the [validation set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-validation-set),
and the [test set](https://morrison-lab.github.io/lds/chapters/big-ideas.html#def-test-set).
They use a different symbol for the training set and a parenthesized observation index, but the same three-way split.

:::
